title: ANT on BELL
subtitle: Robinhood's Anthropic stock token, onboarded step by step. Nothing here is live until it says so.
statusNote: ANT cannot be admitted yet: Chainlink has no ANT feed on Robinhood Chain, and BELL's asset registry refuses a stock token that has no price source.

sources.says: ANT, chain 4663, ASSET_STATUS_ACTIVE, tradable in market, extended and overnight sessions, ISIN US03703U1079

blocker.title: There is no price source for ANT
blocker.what: Chainlink's Robinhood mainnet feed directory lists 62 feeds and none is ANT. Robinhood's docs say feeds exist only for a selected subset of Stock Tokens.
why: BELL's AssetRegistry refuses a stock token without a price adapter and session sources (ERR_STOCK_ADAPTERS, ERR_TOKEN_SOURCE_MISSING). A market-price mode, where the pool prices from its own liquidity, is not something the deployed contracts allow for admission.

A BELL-attested price would need a post-quantum signed report on every update, because each report spends one HybridAuth leaf. Reports must be at most 60 to 300 seconds old depending on the session, so a 4,096-leaf REPORTER key would last roughly three to six days of continuous quoting.
blocker.unblocks: A Chainlink ANT/USD feed on Robinhood Chain. When one is listed the launch is the same sequence as NVDA: four source adapters, the asset queued through hybrid governance, the calendar root, the pool, the Lens.

claims.title: BELL lists Robinhood's real ANT
claims.proof: The address from Robinhood's registry and asset API, with the same runtime code as AAPL, NVDA and TSLA.
claims.passes: Same code hash as the three listed tokens, the Robinhood name, symbol ANT, and Robinhood's own list names the same address.

claims.title: The ANT calendar was signed post-quantum
claims.proof: HybridAuth submit tx and the REPORTER leaf counter before and after.
claims.passes: Tx succeeds with ECDSA and SHRINCS and the leaf counter goes up by one.
claims.blockedBy: Needs the asset admitted first, which needs a price source (B1).

claims.title: The pool is real
claims.proof: Initialize and seed transaction, position id.
claims.passes: Pool id matches, hook is the ANT Einstein hook, liquidity above zero.
claims.blockedBy: Needs the asset admitted (B1) and a seed.

claims.title: The hook cannot trap exits
claims.passes: Low 14 bits are 0x2cc0, and the remove-liquidity bits 9, 8 and 0 are off.
claims.blockedBy: Needs the ANT hook to be deployed.

claims.title: Session fees apply
claims.proof: One swap per session as they occur, fee read from the Swap event.
claims.passes: Fee equals 500, 3000, 5000 or 10000 pips for that session.

claims.title: Caps hold
claims.proof: One reverted swap above the cap.

claims.title: The code is verifiable
claims.proof: Sourcify for the hook and the Lens.
claims.blockedBy: Needs the contracts. The factory builds hooks without a metadata hash, so the hook can only reach match, not exact match.

compliance: ANT is a tokenized debt security issued by Robinhood Assets (Jersey) Limited. It is not Anthropic equity and gives no shareholder rights.
It may not be offered, sold or delivered in the United States or to U.S. persons.
BELL is not affiliated with Robinhood or Anthropic. This page does not use Anthropic's logo or brand marks.
limits: Only the ANT contract that Robinhood lists is considered. ANTc (Coinbase, Base) and ANTon (Ondo, Ethereum and BNB Chain) are on chains where BELL is not deployed, and bridging them would create a new token with its own risk.
A1 shows the token is Robinhood's. It says nothing about whether ANT is a good asset to hold or trade.
No independent cryptographic review of the post-quantum stack exists yet.

rehearsal.title: Rehearsal on Robinhood testnet
rehearsal.note: The same steps ANT needs on mainnet, run with a test token (tANT), a fixture price feed and the Einstein stack deployed on testnet. It is not ANT and it is not mainnet. It shows that the path that does not exist on mainnet yet, adding a stock token after genesis, works.

steps.title: Admitted after genesis through hybrid governance
steps.note: A governance call signed with ECDSA and SHRINCS (HybridAuth leaf 2) queued AssetRegistry.queueAsset, was executed, and the asset was activated.

steps.title: The calendar root was signed post-quantum
steps.note: The root for the asset was queued through a second hybrid-signed governance call, executed, then activated.

steps.title: The pool is real
steps.note: Created and seeded in one transaction through the factory.

steps.title: The hook cannot trap exits
steps.note: hook 0xd67BF333d04FcDf35B4b73CFfA6eD8308789ecC0, low 14 bits 0x2cc0, remove-liquidity bits 9, 8 and 0 off

steps.title: Session fees apply
steps.note: swap in OVERNIGHT, Swap event fee 5000 pips, table says 5000

steps.title: Caps hold
steps.note: a 900 USDG swap reverted with TradeCapExceeded
